title: Use, not killing
text: Here is something most people miss. Veganism is not about not killing animals. It is about not using them. You can exploit animals without killing them: taking eggs from hens, riding horses, shearing sheep for wool, using animals for entertainment. All of these are exploitation, even if the animal is not killed. And you can kill animals without exploiting them: a deer hit by a car, or a mouse dying in a crop harvest, is not use. If veganism were just about not killing, then using animals for labour, taking their eggs or riding them would be acceptable. It is not, because they are still being used. The key question is always the same: are you using this animal as a resource for your benefit? If yes, that is exploitation, and that is what veganism opposes.
